description: Hermes Agent through the vendor's PowerShell installer, found running from the launcher it writes.
why: The vendor's native Windows route puts the whole install under %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes, which no Windows file query reads, so the only witness is the launcher running: `hermes gateway run` keeps hermes.exe alive. require_rows holds the row to the launcher's path. `forbid` names the agents whose skills the installer bundles by name (claude-code, codex) and the other Python agent the Windows scenarios install.
known_gaps: Installed and not running, this install is invisible on Windows: filesystem-windows.sql reads ~\.local\bin and the home's dot-directories, and the installer writes to neither.
The installer's MSIX desktop stage (-IncludeDesktop) is not run; 108-windows-hermes-desktop installs the packaged desktop app instead.
